question: Who was recognized as the Global Peace Ambassador at the India International Conclave 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Babita Singh__.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Serial entrepreneur Babita Singh has been conferred as a Global Peace Ambassador for promoting Peace through Education, Sports, Art, Culture and Diplomacy.
 
• She was honoured at the India International Conclave 2022 held in collaboration with Asia Africa Consortium (AAC), in April 2022.
 
• The AAC-Global Peace Ambassador 2022 honour is the highest honour bestowed on a global citizen.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b86dc18979f224809307fa11485ee8b14a7a31913cc222348bba340bfc67497.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• Recent Awards and Honours:

 
 
• Tarini Goyal bagged the Woman International Master (WIM) norm in Budapest, Hungary, in April 2022.
 
• Eminent Assamese poet Nilamani Phookan has conferred the 56th Jnanpith Award on 11 April 2022, the ceremony of which was held for the first time in Assam.
 
• Mumbai-based journalist Aarefa Johari has won the Chameli Devi Jain Award for an Outstanding Woman Media Person 2021.
